name: DevX Token Snapshot
description: Read-only ERC-20 token data for agents on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, Avalanche and BNB Chain. token_basics (free) returns name, symbol, decimals, total supply and owner/proxy flags from on-chain reads. token_snapshot_info explains the optional paid full snapshot (USD price, FDV, DEX liquidity, top pools, holder hints, risk flags; 0.003 USDC on Base over x402; the tool itself does not pay). No account or API key.
author: devx-agent
